text.p: Checkers Drive-In Restaurants Inc said Monday it appointed Richard Fortman to the position of president and chief operating officer, and Joseph Stein to the newly created position of executive vice president and chief administrative officer.
The company said in a release that both Fortman and Stein are leaving positions with California-based CKE Restaurants Inc.

CKE, in a separate release confirming the departure of the two executives, said Fortman, formerly regional vice president of CKE's Carl's Jr. hamburger chain, "takes to Checkers a proven track record of strong operations leadership."

The company added that Stein, CKE's senior vice president and chief financial officer, who had been with CKE for 18 months, "in a relatively short time, ... demonstrated his efficiency in controlling costs on the corporate side of the business, while improving the support given to operations."

Checkers said Fortman replaces former president and chief operating officer Al DiMarco. The company did not have any information as to DiMarco's future plans, but said he joined the company in 1995 and left after accomplishing what "he came to do."
